claims.text: Adjunct only, not monotherapy: an imidazole or ciclopirox cream on the scalp and selenium sulfide 2.5% shampoo at least twice a week limit spread until cure
claims.quote: Adjunctive topical agents may help reduce transmission but are not sufficient as monotherapy. An imidazole or ciclopirox cream can be applied to the scalp to prevent spread, especially to other children, until tinea capitis is cured; selenium sulfide 2.5% shampoo should also be used at least twice a week.
